title: FLA binary import drops document/view state the model carries: ruler guides skipped in CPicPage tail, grid settings + ruler units never read back, layer heightMultiplier discarded
description: Implemented READ-side FLA import of document/view state (task 1411). flash8-binary.ts: readCPicPage now decodes the CPicPage-tail guide array (u32 guideCount + {u32 direction; u32 valueTwips}) into Fla8Timeline.guides; readCPicLayer reads the F4+ heightMultiplier byte into Fla8Layer.heightMultiplier; parseFla8Contents decodes rulerUnitType/gridVisible/gridSpacingPx/gridColor from the §8.4 stage block anchor-relative to '03 B4 00 00 00'. flash8-import.ts: convertLayer sets layer.height = heightMultiplier*20; buildFla8Document unions per-scene guides into doc.properties.guides (dedup by orientation+position), maps rulerUnitType->RulerUnits, and builds grid settings from decoded fields. Docs/21 §8.4 + §10.1 updated. Tests: new import-viewstate.test.ts (8 tests) — grid/ruler decode vs Magnet.fla fixture + full importer, layer height round-trip via saveRealFla->tryLoadRealFla, guide read via synthesised CPicPage tail + buildFla8Document union/dedup. Full ordered build exit 0; @flash/core tests green (348 files pass, 1 skip). NOTE: guide WRITE side is task 1386 — once it emits guideCount>0 the plain saveRealFla guide round-trip closes; this task is the read complement.
